description: A form of eczema characterized by coin-shaped, dry inflammatory plaques.
causes: Eczematous inflammation; triggers can include dry skin and irritant exposure

appearance.general: Round or coin-shaped dry, scaly, inflamed plaques may occur on the limbs or trunk.

prevention: Maintain skin hydration and reduce avoidable irritant exposure.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss whether fungal testing is needed if lesions have an expanding border or do not respond as expected.
